About Me

A Nurse Who Speaks Your Language

I am a Registered Nurse and certified Medical Virtual Assistant with over two years of remote healthcare administration experience. My clinical background sets me apart from general virtual assistants — I understand medical workflows, documentation standards, and the pressures healthcare providers face every day.

This means I can integrate into your practice with minimal onboarding, handle sensitive patient information with the same confidentiality standards you hold yourself to, and contribute meaningfully from day one — not just administratively, but clinically.

I have worked with healthcare providers across the UK and internationally, and I am fully eligible to work in the United Kingdom with a National Insurance Number and Share Code available.
